news.body: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has charged Goliath Ventures Inc. and its CEO, Florida resident Christopher Delgado, with running a Ponzi scheme built on fraudulent solicitations for bitcoin and ether trading. The complaint was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida.Roughly 1,600 customers contributed at least $397 million to the scheme, while Delgado and Goliath misappropriated all customer funds.
